C0196.title: Python Script for Automated Bulk Following on Instagram
C0196.summary: A CSDN blog post details a Python script designed to automate bulk following of Instagram users. The script navigates to each target user's profile, locates the blue 'Follow' button, and clicks it to perform mass follow actions for follower growth tasks.

references.title: Using a Python Open-Source Bot and $5, I Got 2,500 Real Followers on Instagram
